name: reboards
title: ReBoards
description: Revamped agile boards: work with relations, group subtasks under their parent, use multiple swimlane levels and plan in time.
changeNotes:
Version 1.3.0:
- Stop searching all issues on widget start to find the base URL.
- Store each board separately, so simultaneous saves of different boards no longer overwrite each other.
- Share your own boards when you can update issues in all of their projects. Owners, system admins and admins of all of a board's projects can edit, unshare and delete shared boards. An unshared board goes back to its owner.
- Fix the selected page not being remembered on boards with pages from a field.

widgets.name: ReBoards
widgets.description: Revamped agile boards: see and create relations, group subtasks under their parent, use one or two swimlane levels and plan in time
